en: An open wooden toolbox on a teacher's desk filled with colorful study tools: cards, dice, a timer, markers, small books and a tablet, bright classroom
Many colorful message bubbles (no writing) flying from a smartphone and folding neatly into one tidy envelope on a desk, clean bright illustration
A big illustrated Hebrew wall calendar (no writing) surrounded by symbols: rain clouds, a torch, olive branch, wheat, a candle, in warm watercolor
A cheerful boy with a kippah giving a big warm smile to a classmate in a sunny schoolyard, flowers, everyone around smiling
Boys with kippot building their own board game at a table with colored paper, markers, scissors and game pieces, excited creative mood
A family living room with boys watching a big screen showing a painted Torah story scene, popcorn bowl, warm evening light
a sweet chubby baby boy about one year old, in a light blue onesie, tiny knitted kippa, rosy cheeks, laughing (head-and-shoulders portrait, plain pastel background)
a happy little boy about six years old with a small knitted kippa and tzitzit, white shirt (head-and-shoulders portrait, plain pastel background)
a cheerful yeshiva bachur teenager about seventeen, black velvet kippa, white shirt, first light beard fuzz (head-and-shoulders portrait, plain pastel background)
a warm young father about thirty five with a short neat dark beard, black kippa, white shirt (head-and-shoulders portrait, plain pastel background)
a friendly melamed teacher about forty five with a full brown beard, black hat, glasses, holding a small book, white shirt and dark jacket (head-and-shoulders portrait, plain pastel background)
a dignified kind rabbi about sixty with a long grey beard, black hat and black long coat, holding a sefer (head-and-shoulders portrait, plain pastel background)
